help:
usage: st web [-h] {search,research,fetch,batch,refocus,doctor,benchmark} ...

Run centralized web research using Agent Hub's shared tool stack.

positional arguments:
  {search,research,fetch,batch,refocus,doctor,benchmark}
    search              Search the public web.
    research            Search first, then fetch one result through the shared
                        web stack.
    fetch               Fetch and extract a webpage.
    batch               Fetch URLs serially, reuse HTTP connections, and
                        retain full artifacts.
    refocus             Refocus a full extracted artifact in the owner cache
                        without network access.
    doctor              Verify the configured Lightpanda binary, exact digest
                        and version (no network).
    benchmark           Run deterministic local web fetch benchmarks.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
help.batch:
usage: st web batch [-h] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--focus-query FOCUS_QUERY]
                    [--backend {auto,direct,jina,lightpanda}]
                    [--selector SELECTOR] [--wait-script WAIT_SCRIPT]
                    [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--compact]
                    urls [urls ...]

positional arguments:
  urls                  HTTP or HTTPS URLs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --max-chars MAX_CHARS
  --focus-query FOCUS_QUERY
  --backend {auto,direct,jina,lightpanda}
  --selector SELECTOR   Lightpanda only: extract the first matching CSS
                        element
  --wait-script WAIT_SCRIPT
                        Lightpanda only: wait for a predicate on scoped
                        readable content (see example below)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Positive request/process deadline in seconds (default
                        20)
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON

Scoped readiness example:
  --backend lightpanda --selector article
  --wait-script 'document.querySelector("article")?.innerText.includes("Conclusion")'

Match expected readable content in the target article or #report.
document.body.textContent can include inline scripts and styles, causing
a predicate to pass before the readable content is ready. Prefer scoped
innerText and verify the returned facts after readiness passes.

Coverage: direct content_complete describes the returned extraction view.
coverage.source_completeness remains unverified; JavaScript readiness does
not prove full source coverage. Verify the returned facts.

help.research:
usage: st web research [-h] [--query QUERY] [--max-results MAX_RESULTS]
                       [--result-index RESULT_INDEX]
                       [--search-type {text,news}] [--timelimit {d,w,m,y}]

  --timelimit {d,w,m,y}

  --focus-query FOCUS_QUERY

                        before truncation
  --backend {auto,direct,jina,lightpanda}

  --selector SELECTOR   Lightpanda only: extract the first matching CSS

help.search:
usage: st web search [-h] [--query QUERY] [--max-results MAX_RESULTS]
                     [--search-type {text,news}] [--timelimit {d,w,m,y}]
                     [--compact]
                     [query_arg]

positional arguments:
  query_arg             Search query

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --query QUERY         Search query
  --max-results, --limit MAX_RESULTS
                        Max results to return
  --search-type {text,news}
                        Search scope
  --timelimit {d,w,m,y}
                        Optional search recency filter
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON

summary: Public web search, research, and fetch through Agent Hub.

examples: st web fetch https://example.com/article --backend lightpanda --selector article --wait-script 'document.querySelector("article")?.innerText.includes("Conclusion")'
precautions: Uses Agent Hub's supported web-research executable and owner-managed credentials.
Default ST output writes a local details artifact; --raw emits the owner's JSON.
Use --backend direct for deterministic local benchmark verification.
Lightpanda is opt-in DOM retrieval with an exact local binary pin; use doctor before retrieval.
Use --selector and --wait-script to scope Lightpanda retrieval; readiness does not prove complete source coverage.
Inspect scoped innerText in readiness predicates; document.body.textContent can match scripts/styles before readable content is ready. Verify returned facts.
Fetch retains full extracted artifacts; refocus reads the owner cache without network and batch reuses one HTTP client.
usage.when: research public web sources; use search or fetch for a known page
